notes: RBox revision of a role chain: stands_in o in_time_zone -> in_time_zone (a building keeps the time zone of the city it stands in) is removed. Every model holds the time-zone chain, and a building's time zone is almost never written down, so the instances turn on the chain. stands_in (building or landmark in a city) is tagged with this chain only, so there is no premise route back. The statement is positive ('can observe a different time zone') so the negation has one negation. The first instance (and the cross-lingual queries) asks whether the time zone follows (yes, then no), the second whether, given only the facts, the Alamo could keep another time zone (no, then yes). Near asks another role chain in the topic (yes). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
